about: Target illuminance for the museum's architecture by use class. A stage names a class for each walked or seen surface; Light holds it at every reference moment (Light.MeetsTarget). Values are maintained illuminance, the level below which the average must never fall. Care limits for works are Art's (Data/Art/Care.json), not these.

classes.use: Corridors, passages between stages, the walking zones of halls and galleries

evidence.row: Traffic zones and general areas inside buildings: circulation areas and corridors (100 lx, UGRL 28, Uo 0.4, Ra 40)
Bright primary surfaces for corridors, staircases and entrance halls: walls 75 lx, ceilings 50 lx, uniformity 0.10 at minimum

classes.use: The same routes after dusk when few visitors walk them; the museum never closes (D-006)
classes.analogueOf: EN 12464-1 health-care premises: corridors during the night

evidence.row: Health care premises, rooms for general use: corridors during the night (50 lx, UGRL 22, Uo 0.4, Ra 80)

classes.use: Stairs, the Rotunda's spiral stair, ramps with steps; held day and night

evidence.row: Traffic zones and general areas inside buildings: stairs, escalators, moving walkways (100 lx, UGRL 25, Uo 0.4, Ra 40)
Bright primary surfaces for corridors, staircases and entrance halls: walls 75 lx, ceilings 50 lx, uniformity 0.10 at minimum

classes.use: Lift cars and landings, the Élan glass car

evidence.row: Traffic zones and general areas inside buildings: elevators, lifts (100 lx, UGRL 25, Uo 0.4, Ra 40)

classes.use: The arrival space: the Rotunda around the gilt sun, the Atrium

evidence.row: Places of public assembly, general areas: entrance halls (100 lx, UGRL 22, Uo 0.4, Ra 80)
Bright primary surfaces for corridors, staircases and entrance halls: walls 75 lx, ceilings 50 lx, uniformity 0.10 at minimum

classes.use: Low light that shows the way through a darkened space: the Cube's sealed shell during a performance, a gallery at night
classes.analogueOf: EN 12464-1 health-care premises: night lighting, observation lighting

evidence.row: Health care premises: night lighting, observation lighting (5 lx, Ra 80)

classes.use: Paths of the Grounds and the pond edge after dusk

evidence.row: General circulation areas at outdoor workplaces: walkways exclusively for pedestrians (5 lx, Ra 20)

classes.use: The floor under every other class: no walked route in any configuration falls below it
classes.referencePlane: floor along the path of egress

evidence.row: An average of one foot-candle along the path of egress; 1 fc = 10.764 lx

viewerAge.note: Older visitors may need two to three times the illuminance for the same visual experience; a class is a floor, never a ceiling, for architecture.

sources.title: EN 12464-1:2011 Lighting of indoor workplaces (June 2011), schedule of lighting requirements, as reproduced in Zumtobel, The Lighting Handbook, 6th edition, April 2018, pp. 30-37
EN 12464-2:2007 Lighting of outdoor workplaces (October 2007), as reproduced in Zumtobel, The Lighting Handbook, 6th edition, April 2018, p. 42
TRILUX Lighting Practice, lighting of public areas: corridors, entrance halls, cloakrooms (requirements of EN 12464-1)
Glamox, 'Change for the better' on EN 12464-1:2021: required and modified illuminance; wall, cylindrical and ceiling illuminance as indicators of room brightness
Wikipedia, 'Emergency light': the requirement of an average of one foot-candle along the path of egress (NFPA 101 practice)
ERCO, 'Museum lighting with 50lx': the origin of the 50 lx rule and the age of the observer

unverified: The 2021 edition's rows (EN 12464-1:2021 adds a 'modified' illuminance and wall, ceiling and cylindrical values per row); the values above are the 2011 rows as reproduced by Zumtobel, and the wall and ceiling minimums come from TRILUX without an edition named.
The reference plane 'floor' for traffic zones (EN 12464-1 notes illuminance at floor level for circulation; the note itself was not read).
IES Lighting Handbook and ANSI/IES RP-30-17 values for circulation and orientation in museums (the RP-30-17 preview refused automated reads).
CIBSE SLL Code for Lighting and CIBSE LG8 values (not publicly readable).
EN 1838 escape-route illuminance (1 lx on the centre line) was not read from a source; the escape floor uses the NFPA 101 figure as summarised by Wikipedia.
